workflow.assignment.no-approval-unit: The service does not say which office approves this step.
workflow.assignment.no-level: No office above the handling one is of the level this step names.
workflow.assignment.no-parent: The handling office has no office above it for this step.
workflow.check.dead-end: A case in the state "{state}" can never reach an end.
workflow.check.duplicate-action: The state "{state}" has the action "{action}" more than once without conditions that tell them apart.
workflow.check.duplicate-state: The state "{state}" is defined more than once.
workflow.check.end-exit: The end state "{state}" cannot be left.
workflow.check.invalid: The definition is not valid here: {detail}
workflow.check.many-starts: The workflow has more than one start state: {states}.
workflow.check.many-timeouts: The waiting state "{state}" has more than one timeout without conditions that tell them apart.
workflow.check.no-end: The workflow has no end state.
workflow.check.no-start: The workflow has no start state.
workflow.check.sod-state: The state "{state}" keeps apart from "{other}", which is not a step a person acts on.
workflow.check.start-event: The start "{state}" is left by an action, not by an event or a timeout.
workflow.check.task-event: The task "{state}" is left by a person's action, not by an event or a timeout.
workflow.check.timeout-without-sla: The waiting state "{state}" has a timeout but no time limit.
workflow.check.unknown-effect: No installed module provides the effect "{effect}".
workflow.check.unknown-role: No installed module defines the role "{role}" as one that acts on cases.
workflow.check.unreachable: No transition leads to the state "{state}".
workflow.check.wait-action: The waiting state "{state}" is left only by an event or its timeout, not by an action.
workflow.notify.escalated: Case {number}: the step "{state}" in an office below yours is overdue.
workflow.notify.overdue: Case {number}: the step "{state}" in your office is overdue.
workflow.refusal.comment-required: Write a comment for this action.
workflow.refusal.final-state: The case is closed: nothing more can be done on it.
workflow.refusal.guard-failed: The case's facts do not allow this action now.
workflow.refusal.no-eligible: Nobody in this office or above it may take the next step: ask an administrator to assign the role.
workflow.refusal.no-form: This step takes no form answers.
workflow.refusal.not-an-action: The case is waiting for an event or its time limit, not for a person's action.
workflow.refusal.not-an-event: The case is not waiting for an event.
workflow.refusal.reject-not-allowed: Your role may not reject this case.
workflow.refusal.role-required: This step is taken by another role or another office.
workflow.refusal.separation-of-duties: You acted on an earlier step of this case: another person takes this one.
workflow.refusal.stale: The case changed since you opened it: reload it and try again.
workflow.refusal.unknown-action: This action is not one the case's current step has.
workflow.refusal.unknown-state: The case is in a state its workflow does not know.
workflow.refusal.wrong-system-actor: This event is not one this system may deliver.
